conditions.description: The migration drops customers.legacy_account_number inside the committed migration.
conditions.rationale: Dropping a populated column is irreversible without an independent backup or recovery path.

conditions.description: orders.external_reference is made NOT NULL without any backfill or validation step in the migration.
conditions.rationale: Existing NULL rows can make the migration fail or force an unsafe deployment sequence.

conditions.description: invoices.total_cents is renamed directly to amount_cents without a compatibility period in this migration.
conditions.rationale: Deployments with old and new application versions can disagree on the column contract during rollout.

conditions.description: idx_orders_customer_id is created with a normal CREATE INDEX inside the transaction rather than concurrently.
conditions.rationale: On PostgreSQL this form can take stronger locks than the explicitly concurrent index later in the same migration.

conditions.description: idx_invoices_created_at explicitly uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.
conditions.rationale: The migration contains this reduced-locking index form and it must not be reported as a normal CREATE INDEX.

conditions.description: The migration is explicitly wrapped by BEGIN and COMMIT.
conditions.rationale: Transaction markers are present and should not be falsely reported as absent.

conditions.description: Whether any existing orders.external_reference rows are NULL is not established by the migration file.
conditions.rationale: Production row contents require database evidence outside the fixture.

conditions.description: Whether a tested backup or point-in-time recovery path exists is not established by this migration.
conditions.rationale: Recovery readiness depends on external operational evidence.

conditions.description: The migration must not be cleared as zero-downtime safe from this artifact alone.
conditions.rationale: It combines a direct rename, a new NOT NULL constraint, and a non-concurrent index operation.

conditions.description: The migration must not be cleared as safely reversible.
conditions.rationale: A column is dropped while backup/recovery evidence remains unknown.
